reviews.review: The game is good.  Really good.  It has.....like......graphics and stuff....and swords.  You should totally get it.  It's in space....it has space zombies.  Ten tens out of ten.
the best action free to play game on steam

So I picked this game back up after quitting a number of months ago and I'm starting to remember why I loved it so much to begin with. I'm going to take this review in a slightly different direction than my others in order to break it all down.

The good:
•Solid controls
•Optimization. I play this game on a toaster of an Acer laptop and I'm clocking ~60fps on a few low settings here and there.
•Tons of warframes (Characters you play as) and weapons to suit your favorite gameplay.
•An amazing Free-To-Play system; You don't have to spend a single cent of your hard-earned money on this game if you don't want to all whilst getting what you want. More on this later.
•Randomly generating tileset for every mission so there's some sort of variety and not just the same old map every single time. Only exception is defense missions.
•VERY helpful community and a dev team who regularly keeps in contact with said community.

The bad:
•TONS of Grinding. Warframe revolves around this mechanic. If you want that nice gun you've been eyeing and need specific bits and pieces for it, be ready to play the same mission over and over. The random generator for loot drops is a cruel and unforgiving mistress.
•The waiting time on crafting items can be long and gruelling. 
•Gameplay gets VERY repetitive and stale over time. Understanding the unique approach of the random tilesets keeps every mission you play pretty fresh and enjoyable, but at the same time the end goal is exactly the same no matter how you look at it; Drop in, kill bad guys, reach objective A, kill bad guys, reach objective B, kill a few more baddies, drop out.
•The games forums can be biased at times, as there have been more than a few times where players have been banned from both the forums and the game itself for no good reason. The "Big Brother is Watching" complex is seen a little too well on the forums and needless to say it's a tad frightening. I recommend using the subreddit instead.
•While there is going to be your favorite weapon, there will always be another that will outplay yours. For example, there are many bows in the game. However the only ones that are worth your time are the Rakta Cernos and Dread. My favorite weapon in the game is the Attica(Automatic Crossbow), yet can be outplayed by both the Latron(Single-fire Carbine) and the Paris(Bow) unless you're willing to put a decent build for it.
•The trade chat is notorious for scammers. Be sure to keep warframe.trade open in your internet browser to make sure you're not getting ripped off.

The ugly:
•The complimentary bugs that show up with every update. It's unfortunate to say that is a necessary evil, but on the plus side the dev team is quick to fix these. Some more than others.
•Platinum. If you have a spending problem, I strongly warn you that under no circumstance should you purchase any. If you wanted to purchase a weapon off the Market along with a decent Warframe, you're already looking at well over $20. Unless it's a cosmetic you can't live without, [b]It's not worth it.[/b]
•The gameplay during missions is fast paced. The crafting system is not. Keep that in mind.

To conclude, this game is pretty decent and many other companies could learn a thing or two from Warframe when making a Free-to-Play game.

TL;DR: You know the gaming industry has messed up somewhere when a studio of ~80 strong pushes out a title with so much content to rival AAA developers, and do so [b]for free[/b] and the turnout is infinitely better than yours.
